title: Variable-dimension Weisfeiler–Leman equivalence on general and subcubic graphs

abstractEnglish: Deciding joint-update k-dimensional Weisfeiler–Leman equivalence is $`\mathsf{EXPTIME}`$-complete when the two graphs are given by explicit adjacency matrices and k ≥ 2 is encoded in binary. The result holds even for connected simple uncolored graphs of equal positive order and maximum degree at most three.
titleEn: Variable-dimension Weisfeiler–Leman equivalence on general and subcubic graphs
titleZh: 一般图与次三次图上的变维Weisfeiler–Leman等价

details.overview: 稿件研究联合更新k维Weisfeiler–Leman等价的判定复杂度。作者声称：当两个图以显式邻接矩阵给出、且k≥2以二进制编码时，该问题为EXPTIME完全；该结论即使在连通、简单、无着色、阶数相同且最大度不超过三的图上仍成立。这刻画了变维WL等价判定的计算难度，对图同构与描述复杂性研究有理论意义。
keyPoints: 判定联合更新k维WL等价在显式邻接矩阵与二进制k下为EXPTIME完全
结论对连通简单无着色、同阶且最大度≤3的图仍成立
